4694-5805-7306-8249.notablePrerequisites:
At least one opponent has lost life this turn.
You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
4694-5805-7306-8249.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Gev.
Resolve Defiant Salvager's ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 1.

2023-3480-3755-4770.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

625-1978-8190.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creatures with different powers.
625-1978-8190.description:
Cause Loot to become an artifact using Ashnod's Transmogrant.
Activate Loot by tapping it, adding at least {3}
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Loot.
Repeat from step 2.

301-978-4738.description:
Activate Goblin Sledder by sacrificing Putrid Goblin
When Putrid Goblin dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Vizier of Remedies.
Resolve the Goblin Sledder ability.
Repeat.

413-4559-7096-7306.easyPrerequisites: You've had two lands enter this turn.
413-4559-7096-7306.notablePrerequisites: Noncreature artifacts you control have total mana value 11 or greater.
413-4559-7096-7306.description:
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}, which enters with at least two +1/+1 counters on it due to Bioengineered Future.
When Metalwork Colossus enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Metalwork Colossus.
When Metalwork Colossus dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen token for each +1/+1 counter Metalwork Colossus had.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing two Mutagens, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1020-2866-4659-6967.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Myr Retriever, adding {C}{C}.
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Scrap Trawler by paying its mana cost, which is reduced by Honest Rutstein.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Scrap Trawler, adding {C}{C}.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Retriever by paying its mana cost, which is reduced by Honest Rutstein.
Repeat.

1069-6747-7070.notablePrerequisites: You control three or more artifacts including an Equipment.
1069-6747-7070.description:
Activate an Equipment's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, targeting another nontoken creature you control.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending the targeted creature.
The equip ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast the creature from exile by paying {0}
Repeat.

222-527-2511-7060.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

Resolve the Shilgengar ability.

Activate Greta by paying {G} and sacrificing a Food, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token and a Food token.
Activate the Food by tapping it, adding {G}.
Repeat.

Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Phantom Train twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

527-542-5223.notablePrerequisites:
You have a creature card in hand that can be cast using only colored mana.
Selvala can tap to produce at least {1}{G}{G}{G} plus enough mana to cast the other creature card.
527-542-5223.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{G}{G}{G} plus enough mana to cast a creature card from your hand.
Cast a creature card by paying its mana cost.
Tidespout Tyrant triggers, returning Selvala from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Selvala by paying {1}{G}{G}.
Tidespout Tyrant triggers, returning the creature cast in step 2 from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

Activate Jade Mage by paying {2}{G}, creating three 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate the Saprolings by tapping them, adding {2}{G}.

Cast Myr Retriever by paying {0}.
When Myr Retriever enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Myr Retriever and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning Junk Diver from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Junk Diver by paying {0}.
When Junk Diver enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Junk Diver and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Junk Diver dies, it triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2845-3296-3556-3584.notablePrerequisites:
You have cast at least one instant or sorcery this turn.
You control at least two Forests.
2845-3296-3556-3584.description:
Cast Flicker by paying {1}{W}, targeting Hag Hedge-Mage.
Thousand-Year Storm triggers, copying Flicker at least once, with each copy targeting Quintorius Kand.
Resolve the first copy of Flicker, blinking Quintorius Kand.
Any remaining copies of Flicker fizzle due to having no legal target.
Resolve the original Flicker, blinking Hag Hedge-Mage.
When Hag Hedge-Mage enters the battlefield, its second ability triggers, putting Flicker on top of your library from your graveyard.
Activate Quintorius Kand's second loyalty ability by removing three loyalty counters from it, causing you to exile Flicker from the top of your library and cast it without paying its mana cost, targeting Hag Hedge-Mage.
Quintorius Kand and Thousand-Year Storm trigger.
Resolve the Quintorius Kand trigger, dealing 2 damage to each opponent and causing you to gain 2 life.
Resolve the Thousand-Year Storm trigger, copying Flicker at least twice, with each copy targeting Quintorius Kand.
Repeat from step 3.
You may optionally target any permanent using the additional Flicker copies to blink them.

567-1308-1981-4591-4740.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 50.
567-1308-1981-4591-4740.description:
Activate Aetherflux Reservoir by paying 50 life, dealing 50 damage to yourself.
Darien triggers, creating 100 1/1 Soldier creature tokens.
When the Soldiers enter the battlefield, Soul's Attendant triggers 100 times, causing you to gain 100 life.
Repeat.

1952-2423-2792.notablePrerequisites:
Livio does not have summoning sickness.
You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {5}{W}{W}{W}.
1952-2423-2792.description:
Activate up to seven mana-producing lands by tapping them, adding at least {5}{W}{W}{W}.
Activate Livio's first ability twice by paying {2}{W}{W}, exiling Great Whale and Bounding Krasis with aegis counters on them.
Activate Livio's second ability by paying {2}{W} and tapping it, returning Great Whale and Bounding Krasis from exile to the battlefield.
Bounding Krasis and Great Whale enter the battlefield, triggering their abilities.
Resolve the Great Whale trigger, untapping up to seven lands you control.
Resolve the Bounding Krasis trigger, untapping Livio.
Repeat.

565-2450-2743.description:
Cast Whim of Volrath with buyback by paying {2}{U}, targeting Biovisionary.
Orvar's first ability triggers, creating a copy of Biovisionary.
Resolve Whim of Volrath, changing nothing and returning it to your hand.
Repeat two additional times, foregoing paying the buyback cost on the final iteration.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers.
Resolve the first Biovisionary trigger, causing you to win the game.

220-1110-3828.notablePrerequisites:
Druid's Call attached to Brash Taunter.
You have a way to deal damage to Brash Taunter.
220-1110-3828.description:
Deal damage to Brash Taunter.
Brash Taunter and Druid's Call triggers.
Resolve the Brash Taunter trigger, dealing that much damage to target opponent.
Resolve the Druid's Call trigger, creating that many 1/1 Squirrel creature tokens.
Each Squirrel enters the battlefield, triggering Terror of the Peaks that many times.
Resolve all but one Terror of the Peaks triggers, dealing that much damage to any target.
Resolve the final Terror of the Peaks trigger, dealing 1 damage to Brash Taunter.
Repeat from step 2.
